summary: New box Part act.: example for sense 1 in Part act. (PrS 86/44)

data.turoyo: Azze tqile su taqolo, nafəq fəlge d ruʕo.
data.translation: Da ging jener hin und wog ihn beim Wagemeister; es ergab sich ein halbes Quentchen.

rationale: First Part act. box, substantival occupational taqolo; keep its nominal use explicit.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC Hanna Dewo/132)

data.turoyo: Kotuqlutu as+sefoqe bu+qapono, ŭ aḥna lo+kuḏʕina bu+qapono!
data.translation: you weigh the utensils with a steelyard balance, and we do not understand (lit. ‘know about’) the steelyard balance!

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: actual trade weighing with an instrumental b-complement.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC Hanna Dewo/136)

data.turoyo: Áydarbo, wah, áydarbo g̊toqálnanne bu+qyoso ŭ bi+šehəl?
data.translation: How, oh, how shall I weigh them with a weight and a scane?

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: overt 1sg form plus plural object suffix.

data.turoyo: Ahd nofəl ʕal i ruḥayḏi, hiya šxwa gtoqanna barban dal lirat.
data.translation: Ich gelobe doch, sie gegen Goldpfunde aufzuwiegen.

rationale: Fifth Infectum example: gold equivalence and 1sg/feminine contraction.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC Hanna Dewo/138)

data.turoyo: hənnək kúḏʕistene lappe tuqlənne bu+qyoso ŭ bi+šehəl, ŭ edi tqilənne bu+qapono.
data.translation: they also know that they are unable to weigh them with a weight and scane, and so they weighed them with a steelyard.

rationale: Thin Preterit cell: completed trade weighing.

data.turoyo: Glele aʕle l Slaymanbak, mədle l šakwoṯe, tqəlile b iḏe, omər: "Gqəṭanne."
data.translation: Dann aber deckte er ihn auf, fasste seine Hoden, wog dieselben in der Hand und sagte: »Ich werde ihn tödten.«

rationale: Thin Preterit cell: manual hefting rather than scales.

data.turoyo: Mṭela u qaponči, tqilile, hule ḥaq d Xarmane Ǧuhu w məllale laḥ ḥəmmal, əmmo: “Mawbelu az zaytunani l taḥte d čadərayḏi!” W mṭalle az zaytune l taḥta di čadərayḏa.
data.translation: Sie holte den wage Meister, der wog sie, sie bezahlte dem Juden Charmane den Preis und sagte zu den Lastträgern: Tragt diese Oliven unter mein Zelt! - Das taten sie.

rationale: Fifth Preterit example: a professional weighs commercial produce.

data.turoyo: Əmmo: "Ḥmoro, tqal." Tqile lu ḥmoro. Nafəq u taʕlo yaqər mi kaftare.
data.translation: "Nun wäge", sagte er zum Esel. Da hob der Esel die Wage in die Höhe; aber es ergab sich, dass der Fuchs schwerer war, als der Schakal.

rationale: A whole intelligible balance narrative is clearly better than the inherited isolated tqal; retain edition wording.

summary: No new numbered sense is needed. Weighing, weighing out an equivalent and hefting by hand share the inherited meaning. Instrument b- is distinct from the comparison/counterweight phrases in the bridal examples.
The MAC sequence contrasts ordinary/forward-looking Infectum, negative modal plus bare Infectum and a completed Preterit. Do not classify təqlatli, a negative finite directive, as Imperativ.
taqolo names a professional weigher. It is filed provisionally as a substantival Part act. form, with one example, rather than inventing a new box label or a finite verbal assertion.
Inherited prs 256/3,5 references are grouped beside an ass example even though the supplied flea narrative has a human weighing a flea. No citation is changed without a source-reference concordance.
Confirm occupational taqolo as a substantival Part act. rather than an independent occupational noun. The box records that filing explicitly.
Verify the relationship of prs 187/16 to PrS 66/27 and prs 256/3,5 to the flea narrative before separating or correcting the inherited grouped citations.
Confirm suffix segmentation in g̊toqálnanne, tqilənne and tuqlatte; preserve the source’s diacritics and contractions.
Objects range from utensils, olives and fish to a person or body part; gold may itself be weighed as an equivalent. Manual hefting is still weighing, not a separate estimate sense.
